# Eliquis

Eliquis is a direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) mentioned in the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) quality program documentation as one of the manufacturer-produced information brochures recommended for use in structured patient education about atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The reference appears in a section of the AFDK 2024 report describing Indicator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse), which documents how Danish healthcare clusters should educate patients about atrial fibrillation and anticoagulation treatment, drawing on European ESC guidelines and Danish national recommendations, including the ABC Pathway model of integrated atrial fibrillation care (covering stroke prevention, symptom control, and cardiovascular risk reduction) [^src1].

The corpus provides only a single, brief mention of Eliquis, grouped alongside three other named DOAC products — Xarelto, Pradaxa, and Lixiana — as well as regional brochures on anticoagulation (AK) treatment, all listed as materials recommended for patient education [^src1]. No further details, relationships, or claims about Eliquis are available in the corpus.
